name: draftsman
description: Creates, migrates and audits app specs that coding agents can build from without guessing: one home per fact, every unknown a recorded decision, and a checker that fails while the spec has a gap.

interface.shortDescription: Strict, agent-ready specs for spec-driven development.
interface.longDescription: Creates, migrates and audits app specs that coding agents can build from without guessing: one home per fact, every unknown a recorded decision, and a checker that fails while the spec has a gap.
defaultPrompt: Write a spec for my app idea that agents can build from.
Turn our docs into an agent-ready spec without losing anything.
Audit our spec for gaps and contradictions.
